description: Language-neutral transition scenarios for the two Arbor client state machines. Sources, revisions, roots, updates, cursors, and digests are fixture tokens, not real hashes. Every step names the expected state after the event, the effect types it must emit in order, and optional retained fields checked by dotted path.
